answer_1.quote: With over 1 million open-source models available on HuggingFace (including more than 170,000 text generation models) and prominent leaderboards such as the Open LLM Leaderboard and AlpacaEval tracking over 100,000 models, there is a pressing need for scalable evaluation methodologies.
answer_1.outputs: The paper evaluates LLMs on text generation tasks across multiple benchmarks, focusing on model ranking via generated responses to benchmark questions.

answer_2.quote: The Spearman Coefficient (Sedgwick, 2014) ρ is used for assessing the rank correlation and Pearson Coefficient r is used for assessing Score Distribution Preservation.
